about: Reference catalog for Train/. Codex Design reads this with docs/TRAINING.md. Files stay where the user put them; this file sorts them. Every folder has a TRAIN.md. Categories: stud, voxel-stud, gradient, gfx, simulator-style, texture, vfx.

StudTrain.use: Canonical stud textures. 256x256 alpha overlays, 4x4 studs, dark+white bevel pixels over transparent. Library copies: assets/library/studtrain/ (style 'train' and 'train-mixed').

GradientTrain/Examples.use: Ground truth for the gradient + vignette stud look: 32 *_diff.png renders (transparent, 512x512) and 4 in-scene screenshots (image*.png).

GfxTrain.use: Third-party product cards (VX D2C Stud Street Props), studied for mood only; Codex layouts are original (see TRAIN.md).

StudveGradientVideo.use: Stud Nature Pack 100 Assets walkthrough (62 s). 20 sharp stills in frames/, measurements in TRAIN.md.

TextureTrainSenTrainleBurada.use: Rules for AI-written PBR materials (TRAIN.md). Put texture reference photos here; recipes live in textures/.

TopologyTrain.use: No images: SIMP + CNN background and smart quad topology rules in TRAIN.md.

VfxTrain.use: Roblox VFX Studio knowledge. Library built from the user's VfxPack0/1/2 (Downloads) into assets/vfx/ (63 Roblox flipbooks + 93 particle textures, library.json with licenses and suggested emitter settings).

StudGradientModelKarisik.note: Mixed folder sorted by Codex. The *_diff.png files are byte-identical copies of GradientTrain/Examples.
